content: Curator paraphrase: Wilder's RSI compares average upward and downward price changes and ranges from zero to100. Conventional30/70 boundaries describe oversold/overbought states; strong trends can remain beyond these levels. This supplement interprets a closed return across a boundary as a directional recovery hypothesis, not a publisher-proven entry system. RSI calculation uses14 deltas with Wilder smoothing; context-specific usefulness is measured separately from formula correctness.
